plugins.name: Gladiator
notes: The README documents Minecraft 1.21.6–1.21.11; this is not a guarantee of testing on every server build.
Packet masking requires a compatible PacketEvents installation.

sources.evidence: Documents Bukkit, Spigot, Paper and Purpur on Minecraft 1.21.6 through 1.21.11.
Logs when PacketEvents is not installed and masking is unavailable.

plugins.name: LumenSpoofer
notes: The startup version gate permits Minecraft 1.21.6–1.21.11 and 26.1+; this is not a runtime compatibility guarantee.
The reflective fake-player backend must be tested on each exact Paper build; Bukkit and Spigot are unverified.

sources.evidence: Startup gate permits 1.21.6–1.21.11 and 26.1+; live Paper testing is required.

plugins.name: LumenEconomy
notes: Compiled against Paper API 1.21.4; api-version and compile target do not establish tested Minecraft versions.

sources.evidence: Intends compatibility with Paper, Bukkit-compatible forks such as Purpur, and Folia.

plugins.name: LumenShards
notes: The README describes a Paper build for Minecraft 1.21.6–1.21.11; it does not establish testing on every build.
License validation requires a key, scoped plugin token and allowed server IP; keep credentials private.

sources.evidence: Paper plugin; build for Minecraft 1.21.6 through 1.21.11 with Java 21.

plugins.name: LumenSpawners

errors.title: LumenOrder cannot find an economy provider
match: No Vault economy provider found. Install Vault and an economy plugin; ordering is disabled until then.
errors.cause: The plugin logged that no Vault economy provider was found (LumenOrders, src/main/java/studio/lumen/order/LumenOrderPlugin.java, commit 69a90e0f7faea2087c0db25871a22fb5193a2f56).
steps: Install and enable Vault and a compatible economy provider.
Restart and check the startup log for provider detection.

errors.title: LumenSpawners selling unavailable
match: Vault is enabled but no economy provider is registered; selling is unavailable.
errors.cause: Vault is enabled but no economy provider is registered (LumenSpawners, src/main/java/com/lumenstudios/lumenspawners/LumenSpawnersPlugin.java, commit d0764b696c3e64f32d726125fdeae25179f05195).

errors.title: Gladiator packet masking unavailable
match: PacketEvents is not installed; per-player ore and structure-material masking is unavailable.
steps: Install a PacketEvents release compatible with the exact server software and protocol.
Restart and check the startup log.

errors.title: LumenShards license validation initialization failed
errors.cause: License validation could not initialize; the accompanying exception gives the specific reason (LumenShards, src/main/java/studio/lumen/shards/licensing/PaperLicenseGate.java, commit 59f12d11778d334978da898bf8935d2f32234460).
steps: Check the detailed startup error and licensing configuration locally.
Verify the license, scoped token and allowed server IP with support; never share credentials publicly.
